notes.title: Beyond Mankind joins the Steam Summer Sale with a historic discount!
notes.notes:
Beyond Mankind joins the Steam Summer Sale with a discount of 85% never seen before. Now is the best to get it and save humanity!

Inspired by the classics of the genre from the early 2000s, Beyond Mankind will take you join the ranks of the H.O.P.E. organization, who is trying to go back to Earth in the year 2121 after it was completely devastated by a bloody war and a nuclear Winter. Discover the secrets behind this project and recover your home for the human species.

With FPS, survival and RPG mechanics, as well as a complex dialogue system and decisions that will change the course of your story, Beyond Mankind offers you an adventure like no other. Don't wait any longer to join H.O.P.E. and embark on this epic tale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301590/Beyond_Mankind_The_Awakening/

notes.title: Join H.O.P.E. for the Steam Spring Sale!
notes.notes:
Grab your weapons and prepare to fight alongside H.O.P.E. for the Steam Spring Sale. Explore a postapocalyptic Earth where humankind can no longer live, and find a way to save the species. But you will uncover some dark secrets on the way... Are you ready to face the truth and make your decision?

Beyond Mankind is an ARPG that features survival elements, FPS elements and also has a complex dialogue system that will allow you to build relationships with different characters. Create your own path and make your decisions as you try to survive a nuclear winter and an Earth infested with fearsome creatures.

Beyond Mankind is available for Windows and Linux, and is playable on Steam Deck. We also have a demo available if you want to give it a try before buying it. Don't miss out on it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301590/Beyond_Mankind_The_Awakening/

notes.title: BEYOND MANKIND CELEBRATES ITS FIRST ANNIVERSARY WITH A HUGE SALE!
notes.notes:
Time sure flies! At this time last year, on August 31st of 2021, Beyond Mankind was released. And to celebrate it, the game is on sale, [b]currently 75% off[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37952019/82aaf1251a80f1a35465a4ea26f5794dd9388eb1.png[/img]

We released a postapocalyptic ARPG with a lot of emphasis on the [b]narrative[/b] and the [b]dialogues[/b], [b]survival[/b] mechanics and an intriguing and dark story with [b]sci-fi[/b] touches. We tried to tackle topics in it that we as people find interesting, all while paying homage to the games from the early 2000s that left an impression on this genre. And then we self-published the game. We were so nervous but also so excited to share it with everyone.

A year later we can say that we were able to improve the game along the way in order to deliver the best possible experience, and we even got to release it on Linux! We’ve learnt a lot with this game and we hope you will join us in the celebration of its anniversary by getting it now and helping us save Earth.

Pactum serva!

notes.title: Steam Winter Sale, 30% off for you and your friends
notes.notes:
¡Hello, H.O.P.E. soldiers!

The Steam Winter Sale is here and, as you may have already guessed, Beyond Mankind is joining it. Right now the game is 30% off!

At this time of the year, this is a great chance. Did you like Beyond Mankind and you think one of your Steam friends would love it? Then take this opportunity to show them how much you care! It’s as easy as doing this:
[list]
[*] Add Beyond Mankind to your cart.
[*] Upon checking out, select the “Purchase as a gift” option.
[*] Select the recipient from a list of your Steam friends.
[*] Write a nice message for the recipient.
[*] Finish the check out process.
[/list]
The gift will be automatically sent to your friend once you’re done. Moreover, if you want to buy it now that it’s on sale and give it later, you can also do so. Once you’ve chosen the gift recipient, click on “Schedule delivery” and select the date in which you want them to receive it.

That’s it, it’s as easy as that!

Finally, to those of you who are already a part of H.O.P.E., we want to ask for your participation in one last mission. If you enjoyed your adventure, we’d appreciate it a lot if you wrote a review. That would help us recruit new members for H.O.P.E.!

We wish that you have a nice holiday season and that you go into the new year full of “hope”.

Pactum serva.

notes.title: LAUNCH OF THE 1.1 VERSION OF BEYOND MANKIND
notes.notes:
Hello again, H.O.P.E. soldiers! 

The second patch for Beyond Mankind is here! And it comes with many new things to try out. After listening to all the feedback we got from players both online and in-person as well as lots of testing, the team has been making adjustments to deliver you the best possible game. 

Thus, in this update, you can expect a lot of changes that will significantly improve the player’s experience, from improvements in the more generic aspects of the game like lighting, shading, sound, physics, or AI behavior, to fixes for issues that affected specific levels or sections of the game.

If you want to know what exactly these changes are, here is the full list of all the issues that have been addressed in this patch:

[b]NEW[/b]

[list]
[*] Introduction of new voice off, short cinematics, and reorganization of the existing ones to make the story more cohesive.
[*] New art for the loading screens and other key moments.
[*] Steam achievements and Steam Cloud compatibility.
[*] Two new languages: Chinese and German - Apart from the existing English, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese and French.
[*] The option to skip dialogue by pressing the Enter key.
[*] Support for the OWO haptic vest.
[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduction of the loading times.
[*] Remade and improved the auto-save system.
[*] Restructured the order of the story so that it is better understood.
[*] The decision-making process of the soldiers’ AI.
[*] The physics of the game.
[*] HOPE 281’s behavior.
[*] Improved the uniforms of H.O.P.E. soldiers and enemy troops.
[*] Improved animations during conversation with NPCs.
[*] Improved the movement and reactions of the animals.

[b]BALANCE[/b]

[*] Adjusted the Cold mechanic so that it affects the player in a more progressive way.
[*] Balanced the difficulty of the game as well as the encounters with enemies.
[*] Balanced access to resources.
[*] Adjusted mouse sensitivity.

[b]GENERAL FIXES [/b]

[*] Fixed a major bug that did not save player skills when leaving the game.
[*] Corrected several text errors in different languages.
[*] Changed the smoke of the guns to improve visibility when shooting.
[*] Adjusted the scale of several objects.
[*] Fixed a problem with the Next / Previous weapon key.
[*] Fixed an issue with the display of weapons.
[*] Fixed several errors that affected the inventory section.
[*] Fixed issues with the sounds the Player makes when walking.
[*] Fixed some glow issues with the lantern light.
[*] Fixed several issues regarding sound effects.
[*] Fixed an error that occurred when the Player attempted to pick up a weapon with a flashlight.
[*] Fixed general shading issues.
[*] Fixed the error in the audio level sliders.
[/list]

[b]ADDITIONAL FIXES[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issues with enemy soldiers' behavior during the battle scenes of the Wasteland, the Belgian city, and the metro.
[*] Homogenized the lighting in different scenes of Avalon and the spaceship.
[*] Fixed lighting issues in the base corridors and the metro.
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred upon the initialization of the Omega door puzzle in the space station.
[*] Fixed a bug with ISS / Space station mines.
[*] Fixed a problem with Vishpala and Bodo’s gestures while chatting.
[*] Fixed issues in the Omega Palesack combat.
[*] Fixed the errors that affected the ability to save and load the inventory in the battle of the ISS hangar.
[*] Fixed many other minor bugs.
[/list]

That’s all for now, but the team will keep working, and we’ll be paying a lot of attention to your feedback after this update. We’re here to listen to you, always striving to improve. So if you have any other issues, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

And as always, thank you for all the support and for believing in us! We appreciate it a lot.

[h1]Pactum Serva.[/h1]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.1 for Beyond Mankind
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, H.O.P.E. recruits![/b]

Here is the first patch for Beyond Mankind! We take your feedback very seriously, so we’ve been working very hard to improve the experience the game offers. 
In this patch we’ve fixed bugs and balance issues that affected the ability to advance in some missions. We’ve also made changes and some adjustments that will make the game feel better and improve immersion overall.

Here’s a detailed list of everything that’s been addressed in the patch:

[b]Bugs and errors[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed text errors in different languages, as well as an issue that made messages in English appear while playing in other languages.
[*] Fixed a bug involving the visibility and detonation of mines.
[*] Fixed a problem with NPC soldiers passing through walls.
[*] Fixed a bug in which Perk Points disappeared in the kerbit.
[*] Fixed a bug where equipment was lost at the beginning of a scene.
[*] Fixed a bug with the door UI.
[*] Fixed an issue with HOPE281 animations in the gym scene.
[*] Other general minor bugs fixed
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the lantern light during the Wasteland scene.
[*] Addressed balance issues and NPC behaviour in the battle scene of the Wasteland.
[*] Made adjustments to mouse sensitivity.
[*] Improved the performance of long-range aiming with firearms.
[*] Changed the interface of the inventory so that selected items light up.
[*] Added some clarifications to the objective of a mission.
[/list]

[b]Languages[/b]
[list]
[*] Texts in German and Chinese have been implemented.
[/list]

But this is only the beginning! We’re still working and listening to your feedback, and we appreciate everyone that has helped us by reporting issues. We’re very grateful for your trust and your patience.
We haven’t forgotten about the languages that are still missing and the Linux version. As promised, they will be ready in the coming weeks, so be sure to stay tuned for those!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37952019/893f3e0e311d580532e3a38354e64276f7779fca.png[/img]

Pactum serva.

notes.title: FINAL UPDATE BEFORE RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello, H.O.P.E. soldiers!

The Brytenwalda Studios team is very excited about the release of BEYOND MANKIND! But before that, we have some updates for you.

[h1]LAUNCH DISCOUNT![/h1]

We would like to reward our most loyal players and the people who have supported us during development, so that’s why BEYOND MANKIND will have a [b]30% discount in its first week after release[/b]! Don’t miss this opportunity to grab it!

Next week we intend to hold a [b]giveaway[/b] on our social media. Be sure to follow us on Twitter and Instagram to stay updated and to make sure you don’t miss it!
Twitter: twitter.com/brytenwaldateam
Instagram: instagram.com/brytenwaldastudios

[h1]SOME IMPORTANT NEWS[/h1]

We also have some updates on Beyond Mankind’s development for you, which include important news regarding the game’s launch.

First of all, we’d like to let you know that at launch the game will be available in the following [b]languages[/b]: Spanish, French, English, and Portuguese. Due to a situation out of our control, we will add the rest of the languages in an update that we’ll have ready in the coming weeks after release. We expect to have them included by the end of September.

As for [b]gamepad compatibility[/b], we’re still working on it, but it’s almost done, so it should be ready soon after release too. We strive to bring you the best possible gaming experience, so we’re making a few improvements and adjustments to make sure everything will be perfect when it’s implemented.

We also have some news concerning the [b]Linux and MAC[/b] versions. After having some last-minute problems, we’ve decided to postpone their launch to make sure that they work perfectly, but they should be ready in the coming weeks.

All we can say is that we’re very sorry about these last-minute changes. Sometimes things don’t go as planned even if you do your best to make sure everything works and will be ready on time. As players ourselves, we understand that this can be frustrating for our fans. But we’re set on bringing you an incredible experience, so that’s why we ask that you bear with us. Everything we promised will be delivered in the first few days/weeks after release. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[b]BEYOND MANKIND launches on August 31st[/b], and we’ll keep on working to deliver the best experience we can. Pactum Serva!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37952019/d9a032f2cafca5eb084a94c29c20e97b00a2f64c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Updates on the BEYOND MANKIND development.. We're so close to release!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Beyond Mankind - Action RPG
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301590/Beyond_Mankind/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37952019/27bc33807d70aa2fec2d48872e21ab2a1d0f3df4.png[/img][/url]

[b]Brytenwalda Studios[/b] announce its next game for the PC platform. [b]Beyond Mankind[/b] combines Role-playing and Action with Survival mechanics ([b]SARPG[/b]) to create a new experience, expanding gameplay horizons.

[b]Beyond Mankind[/b] takes place in a dark future where the Earth is suffering the last stages of nuclear winter and mankind is exiled in space waiting for its moment to recover its home. The player is part of an organization called H.O.P.E., whose only mission is to save humans from extinction. This means to travel back through time about 39,000 years, to where Earth is still a wild and healthy planet. However, the past hides its own dangers.

◂ [b]SETTINGS:[/b]
-Dystopian, post-apocalyptic future
-Bright and vibrant prehistory
-Two opposing worlds, dangerous and cold

◂ [b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
-Focus on narrative and relationships between characters
-Solid atmosphere
-Non-obvious decisions with consequences


[h2]Features[/h2]

[b]SARPG - Survival Action Role-Playing Game[/b]
Try a new genre in gaming that combines survival mechanics with action and role-playing.

[b]Two Overall Settings[/b]
Start in a dark future and be part of humanity’s last hope. Discover a militarized society where individual liberties must come second to survival.
Then travel to a grim past to brave an ice age and its inhabitants.

[b]Quality Content[/b]
Both overall settings, chosen for their interest, have been painstakingly created from historical and scientific sources.

[b]Science-Like Character Creation[/b]
Create a character through a complex attribution system where one picks genetic traits and background.

[b]Complex Narrative[/b]
A main story is accompanied by plenty of side quests, all involving difficult decisions and their fateful consequences.

[b]NPC Interaction[/b]
Make choices in branching conversation trees. Form relationships with the NPCs – each with their own personality and needs – to earn their friendship, loyalty, or even love. Acquire followers and companions.

[b]Survival[/b]
Survive – and help others survive – in many different environments. Seek shelter and make sure to monitor your core temperature, physical condition, and mental state.

[b]Integrated Inventory[/b]
Make camp to view your inventory. There, you can light a fire, set up your tent, manage resources, cook food, and craft items. The game provides a variety of foodstuffs, weapons, and other equipment and materials.

notes.title: Beyond Mankind: Background and Features
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593582/e971dcbe19907299dcd6c845d00ffb64a433c4b9.jpg[/img]

[b]The earth is no longer ours.[/b]

39,000 years ago, a budding human being suffered a random [b]genetic mutation[/b]. The replicators of this gene, named What Remains (WR), were bigger, stronger, and faster than the common human. They clustered into small covert communities, gradually eliminating their genetic competitors, until they decided to [b]annihilate mankind[/b] altogether.

In the middle of the 21st century, they engineered the Great Disaster. Nuclear warheads transformed Earth into a frozen hell. The Replicators could rapidly evolve to adapt to this new environment, acquired great strength and aggressiveness, and became the dominant species.

Only the space colonies remain to [b]preserve human civilization[/b]. Their scientists have created an Einstein-Rosen space/time bridge to send a mission back to the Würm glaciation. Their aim is to obtain genetic samples from when the first mutation appeared and find a way to destroy it.

Two missions were sent to Heinrich Event 4, the coldest moment that humanity has ever known, but contact has since been lost. The player has been assigned to the rescue party, but are hypothermia and Pleistocene megafauna the only threats?

Beyond Mankind is a [b]narrative Action RPG with survival mechanics[/b]. It is divided into [b]three chapters[/b] that present both a dystopic near future and an ancestral world, an isolated glacial valley full of Pleistocene megafauna and hunter-gatherer hominids.

[h3]Survival[/h3]

[h3]Integrated Inventory[/h3]
Make camp to view your inventory. There, you can light a fire, set up your tent, manage resources, cook food, and craft items. The game provides a variety of foodstuffs, weapons, and other equipment and materials.
